description: This file defines the route component for the notes page in a Remix application. It includes a loader function that verifies user authentication and a React component that renders the notes UI placeholder with navigation and a form to create new notes.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loader function that verifies user authentication and prepares data for the route.

methods.name: NotesIndexPlaceholder
methods.description: React component rendering the notes page placeholder UI including header, description, a creation form, and outlet for nested routes.
